summary: Adopt a clarify-before-implement gate: requirements enter a Specify phase where the agent must mark unresolved points (e.g. [NEEDS CLARIFICATION]) and get human answers before planning/implementation; spec-driven workflows (GitHub Spec Kit and equivalents) operationalize this for coding agents.

evidence.summary: GitHub Spec Kit: Specify->Plan->Tasks->Implement workflow; spec is the contract/source of truth for agent work; integrates 30+ agents as of 0.11.0 (2026-06).
2026 SDD guide: versioned structured specifications as source of truth; community reports 60-80% fewer rework cycles vs prompt-driven development.
20,574-session study: incomplete upfront specification is the norm; turn-by-turn intent refinement drives misalignment.

requires: human available to answer clarification questions
spec artifact checked into the repository
not_for: throwaway prototypes where rework cost is trivial

risks: Over-formalization can slow trivial tasks; scope the gate to non-trivial changes.
